dedupe_keys.name: advanced driver assistance system adas equipped single vehicle data for central ohio

description: Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS)-Equipped Single-Vehicle Data for Central Ohio is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "U.S. Department of Transportation Federal Highway Administration. (2023). Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS)-Equipped Single-Vehicle Data for Central Ohio. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from https://doi.org/10.21949/1404213". The datasets contain the subject ADAS-equipped vehicle’s trajectory collected in naturalistic traffic conditions in central Ohio. The instrumented subject vehicle was either a discreet or readily-identifiable ADAS-equipped vehicle with SAE L2 capabilities. The dataset also contains trajectories for adjacent vehicles in traffic (observed by the subject vehicle’s onboard sensors). Coverage: Central Ohio (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 54 columns, among them roadway type, map_origin_y, map_origin_z, pos_y_sv_m, pos_x_sv_f, lanelet_id_av. The portal shows 2023-08-23 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation:. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
